As a result of listening to our employees, CRC Group earned a Top Workplaces USA award three years in a row based solely on employee feedback and CRC Group is currently Great Place To Work Certified! If you want to work for a company where employees are valued and growth is encouraged, CRC Group could be the place. The Azure Cloud Operations Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining Azure cloud infrastructure and services. They collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the availability, scalability, and security of Azure-based applications and systems. This role involves troubleshooting and optimizing Azure environments while staying updated on emerging Azure technologies and best practices within enterprise cloud computing. In addition to supporting the current Azure ecosystem, the Engineer will also play a key role in migrating and securing new client data across the platform. Experience with Terraform is essential and familiarity with DevOps, Terraform, and Microsoft SQL Server IaaS and PaaS is considered a plus. Location: This role is hybrid in Charlotte or Raleigh ideally. We will consider Dallas or Atlanta as well. Responsibilities: Deploy and manage cloud resources (e.g., virtual machines, storage, databases, recovery vaults, key vaults, and networks) using Microsoft Azure. Ensure the security, reliability, and performance of Azure-based infrastructure. Collaborate with development, operations, and cyber teams to support application hosting and integration. Assist with migrating client data and workloads securely to Azure, ensuring compliance and performance standards. Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Azure DevOps pipelines. Monitor and troubleshoot Azure environments, responding to incidents and identifying areas for improvement. Contribute to automation and orchestration efforts to streamline cloud operations. Experience with SQL Server IaaS and PaaS troubleshooting and SQL Server setup. Provide after-hours support via Pager Duty as needed within a rotation. Enroll VMs and SQL Databases into backup center and troubleshoot backup situations. Familiarity with Azure Site Recovery and automation with Disaster Recovery planning. Familiarity with Azure Cost Management and understanding of drilling down into costs and making cost saving cuts with SKU’s, disks, etc., as items are found. Troubleshooting with Windows Server administration and event logs. Requirements: 5 years of related Azure cloud experience. Proficiency with Azure infrastructure, services, and administration. Strong experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform a plus but not a requirement). Experience with SQL Server IaaS and PaaS is a plus. Ability to manage cloud deployments securely and efficiently. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical teams. Demonstrated experience with cloud migration projects is also a plus. Team player but works independently to drive results and raise emergencies as they arise. Relevant certifications: Azure Administrator is highly desired.

review_candidates.description: Become a part of our caring community The Senior Network Operations Engineer supports the stability, security, and performance of the organization's data center and infrastructure environment. This role is responsible for maintaining access controls, monitoring system performance, supporting network operations, and recommending technology improvements to enhance operational efficiency. The ideal candidate is a hands-on IT professional with experience in network operations, Windows and Linux environments, and infrastructure support. The Senior Network Operations Engineer maintains access control, data integrity, and file system security within the computer/data center and infrastructure environment. This position monitors, tracks, and records system performance and utilization metrics while supporting the availability and reliability of critical systems and network operations. The role regularly communicates highly technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences and recommends process, hardware, and software enhancements to improve infrastructure efficiency. This position may also participate in information technology and infrastructure projects and contribute to departmental strategies and operational improvements. Responsibilities Maintain access control, data integrity, and file system security across data center and infrastructure environments. Monitor, track, and record system performance and utilization metrics. Support network operations and troubleshoot infrastructure-related issues. Communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Recommend hardware, software, and process improvements to enhance operational efficiency. Participate in infrastructure and information technology projects. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and departmental strategy discussions. Support the stability, security, and performance of critical systems and services. Required Qualifications 5 or more years of network operations experience. 2 years of corporate IT experience with Windows, Linux, and general networking skills. Our Department of Defense contract requires U.S. citizenship for this position. If selected for the role, you will need to successfully receive interim approval for government security clearance (NBIS – National Background Investigation Service). Working knowledge of all Microsoft Office applications. Preferred Qualifications Associate's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field. Professional IT certifications such as CompTIA Network+, Security+, Linux+, Cisco CCNA, Microsoft certifications, or equivalent industry-recognized credentials. Experience supporting data center, network operations, or infrastructure environments.
